Oil Rig Sinks Off Gabon Coast

A large drilling rig called Prospector 5 sank in the sea near Gabon on the night of October 24 after one of its legs suddenly pushed through the soft seabed during setup work. 

The rig, owned by Borr Drilling and getting ready for a drilling job for BW Energy, had 115 people on board. 

110 Rescued, 1 Dead, 4 Missing 

Search teams continue looking for the missing workers, and authorities are investigating what caused the accident. 

No oil spills or damage to nearby facilities have been reported.
